abilities.declare: Pick 2 or more visible enemy units within 8" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Immolation Cannons** for each unit picked to be the target of this ability, but each time this unit uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, it must target each of those units with at least 3 of its attacks.

abilities.name: Daemonic Strength

• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons.

abilities.name: Pitiless Trampling
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance up to the value of the roll. during that move, this unit can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Peerless Among Daemonsmiths
abilities.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has:
**1** This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

**3** Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by **^^Spells^^**, **^^Prayers^^**, and abilites used by **^^Manifestations^^**. Otherwise, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: The Curse of Stone
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit, then pick a second point on the battlefield within 9" of the first point. Draw a line between the caster and the first point, and between the first and second points. Each enemy unit the lines pass across is a target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged

abilities.name: Master of Daemonic Power

abilities.name: Unholy Stampede
abilities.effect:
While a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Cavalry^^** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:

abilities.name: Battle Damaged

abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified casting roll. Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each roll that equals or exceeds the target's Save characteristic.

abilities.name: Gem of Utorak
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
If this unit is not a **^^Wizard^^**, it has **^^Wizard (2)^^** until the start of your next turn.

If this unit is a **^^Wizard^^**, until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to this unit's power level.
• Add D3 to casting rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Casque of Belittlement
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to each roll. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Horn of the Bullfather

abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut^^** unit to be the target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly **^^Hobgrot Vandalz^^** unit to be a second target.
abilities.effect: Remove each target from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Scroll of Petrification
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• The target has **^^Ward (2+)^^**.
• The target cannot use non-passive abilities or be picked to be the target of friendly abilities.
• Enemy units can ignore the target's combat range for the purposes of movement and charging.
• Enemy units can ignore the target for the purposes of setting up on the battlefield but cannot be set up on the target.

abilities.name: Crucible of Spite
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Give up to 3 **daemonic power points** to this unit. However, you cannot allocate or give any more **daemonic power points** to this unit for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Gauntlets of Punishment
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.effect: Each time a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut^^** unit within the combat range of a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Infantry^^** unit with 1 or more **daemonic power points** uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Experimental Munitions
abilities.effect: Ranged weapons used by friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they have 2 or more **daemonic power points**.

abilities.name: Bulls of the Ziggurat
abilities.effect: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut^^** units for each **daemonic power point** that unit has.

abilities.name: Arcane Dominance
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, chanting rolls, unbinding rolls, and banishment rolls for friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Wizards^^** and **^^Priests^^** while they are wholly within 12" of another friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** with 1 or more **daemonic power points**.

abilities.name: Servile Automaton

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Automaton^^** unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit's bodyguard and the following effects apply:
• While this unit is in combat and its bodyguard is within its combat range, its bodyguard has **^^Strike-first^^**.
• If this unit is **^^Infantry^^**, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^** while its bodyguard is within its combat range.

abilities.name: 'Fire, You Worms!'
abilities.timing: Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Infantry^^** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can immediately use the 'Shoot' ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must have charged this phase. If the unmodified hit roll for any of those attacks is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: An Eye for Weakness
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut^^** units that target that enemy unit.

abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.

abilities.name: Furnace Blessing
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, that unit's melee weapons also have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Storm of Obsidian Shards
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and subtract 3 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: Infernal Motivators
abilities.effect: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic.

abilities.name: Earthwrack Stabilisers
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if it has not charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Bullfather's Scorn
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

This unit's ranged weapons have **^^Crit (2 Hits)^^** until the start of your next turn. If each of this unit's ranged weapons already have **^^Crit (2 Hits)^^**, this unit's shooting attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.

abilities.name: Harness Daemonic Power
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Your Turn
abilities.effect:
You must use this ability at the start of each of your turns. Remove all **daemonic power points** from each friendly unit. Then, gain 1 **daemonic power point** for each friendly **desolation token** on the battlefield.
Then, allocate your **daemonic power points** to friendly non-**^^Hobgrot Helsmiths of Hashut^^** units. Each unit can have a maximum of 3 **daemonic power points**. Then, all unallocated **daemonic power points** are lost.
**Designer's Note:** *Non-***^^Hobgrot^^** *units have abilities that become more powerful depending on how many daemonic power points they have. We recommend using coloured dice to track the number of points each units has.*

abilities.name: Reserves of Daemonic Power
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hobgrot Helsmiths of Hashut^^** unit that has no **daemonic power points** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give 2 **daemonic power points** to the target.

abilities.name: Leave the Land in Ruin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature or objective that does not have a friendly **desolation token** and is contested by a friendly **^^Helsmiths of Hashut^^** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target a **desolation token**.
